items.title: Wilson "Chembo" Corniel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, November 15, 2019
items.q: what we did yesterday with me, Cascadu and Victor with the percussion

ctx.x: Yeah I know, but I’m talking about for us who know this is how we get into that. So but the timbale player will hit a rhythm on the side, like he was showing the drummer. [taps] So if the drummer is on a cymbal [scats]. So he’s playing that phrase, so he’s playing with the clave too. So you go [scats] you see? So therefore this is what we try to do and what we did yesterday with me, Cascadu and Victor with the percussion, all those rhythms from all around the world that we try to — it’s so much more than what we…
What was that word you used?
